_comment: Qwen3.5 checkpoints ship BF16 RMSNorm gains (Qwen3-family convention) — the metal gain-reader symbols must match. Qwen3.5 `*RMSNorm` stores zero-centered gains (`x * (1 + w)`); scratchy keeps the on-disk form and offsets in-kernel. All Qwen3.5 checkpoints are `Qwen3_5*ForConditionalGeneration` wrappers nesting the text decoder under `language_model.*`.
